paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Creative Operations Manager position at HH Global. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your posting puts AI tool rollout and automation at the center of this role. At Charter One I used Claude agentic coding to develop content workflows that cut production times in half while keeping stories authentic. At Lightbox Digital I slashed creative production times by 30% with AI tools and built a complete AI video workflow in Google Veo, Kling, and Midjourney. You get someone who has built AI into real production and measured the time it saves.

The production side is familiar ground. I have delivered 98% of projects on time and 92% within budget while commanding crews of 5 to 20 people. I maintained an organized library of video assets in Frame.io and Dropbox, reducing search and retrieval time by over 50%, which is the same discipline a DAM system needs. At Grand Canyon Education, one of the largest marketing agencies in the country, I delivered 200+ videos over two years reaching millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels, and crystallized scope of work so cross-department stakeholder goals were met and exceeded. I manage projects in Wrike, Notion, and Google Workspace, and my post-production runs on Adobe Creative Cloud and DaVinci Resolve.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

# NOT THE FULL POSTING: search-engine excerpts only

The full job description could not be retrieved. ZipRecruiter returns no description text, Dice and Snagajob have no listing for this employer, Indeed failed to connect, the job sites (ziprecruiter.com, Dayforce, Remotive, Teal, Dreamwork) cannot be fetched from this environment, and the WebSearch budget for this run was used up. ## WebSearch excerpt 1 (query: remotive HH Global Creative Operations Manager USA remote responsibilities requirements)

The Remotive listing for HH Global's Creative Operations Manager is a full-time, USA-only remote role, with no salary listed. Location is USA Only and the posting appeared about a week before the search.

**Responsibilities (per the Remotive listing):** The role covers AI tool rollout, workflow optimization, asset review and quality control, brand compliance, cost and reporting analysis, technical troubleshooting, team resourcing, and client stakeholder communication.

**Requirements (per the Remotive listing):**
- A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field.
- Experience in creative operations or production management, in a client-facing, in-house, or agency setting.
- Proven skill building and running complex creative workflows across digital, print, and video channels.
- Expertise in QC and brand compliance, plus experience adding automation tools to creative work.
- Expert-level use of project management software such as Asana, Workfront, or Smartsheet.
- Experience running a digital asset management (DAM) system, and familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and Google Workspace.

**Other listings differ:** Copies of this role on other job boards add details that aren't in the Remotive posting. One lists a $65k–$95k range and experience with Google proprietary AI tools including Gemini, Veo, Imagen, and others. Another, for a different role, is based primarily remotely in the United States, with travel requirements multiple times per year. Check the Remotive page itself for the current requirements, since the copies may be out of date or describe a different posting.

## WebSearch excerpt 2 (query: "HH Global" "Creative Operations Manager" job $140,000)

The search turned up several HH Global Creative Operations Manager postings, and the $140,000 figure is the top of a range, not a fixed salary.

- **Official posting:** HH Global's own Dayforce listing says the $100,000 to $140,000 range applies only to New York and California applicants, and that other locations may differ. For New York and California applicants: The salary range for this position is $100,000 to $140,000 annually. The posting also notes that actual compensation depends on factors such as skill set, experience, certifications and work location.
- **Oregon listings:** An Indeed listing for the Myrtle Point, OR role shows $100,000 - $140,000 a year. A JobLeads listing for an Oregon hybrid version of the role gives a wider USD 90,000 - 150,000 range.
- **Other figures:** A Dreamwork listing for a remote U.S. role gives $65k - $95k. A Remotive listing shows salary unspecified for a remote, USA-only role.
- **Date caution:** One Dayforce posting is marked as no longer available and describes a 2–4 month contract role, so it may not match current openings.

Bottom line: the $140,000 figure is the upper bound of HH Global's posted range for this title, and the actual offer depends on location and the specific listing. Check the live posting for the role and location you're considering.

pros.point: The posting lists a pay floor of $140,000 a year and says the role is fully remote and full-time. This comes from the job listing, not from employee reviews.

cons.point: The ZipRecruiter listing gives only a minimum salary, with no top of the range and no description text. Without the full posting, the scope, reporting line, and whether the role sits on one client account are unknown. This is a gap in the listing, not evidence about the workplace.

red_flags: No red flags were found, but none were looked for: layoffs, leadership churn, return-to-office mandates, and pay complaints at HH Global all remain unchecked. Treat this as missing data, not a clean record.
The ZipRecruiter listing tags a remote, USA-only role as 'Oregon'. That is most likely a placeholder location, but ask whether any state restrictions or travel requirements apply.
research.bottom_line: This run has nothing usable on what it is like to work at HH Global. The web search limit ran out and the Indeed connector was down, so there are no Glassdoor, Indeed, or Reddit findings. To get a real read, send a follow-up message to rerun the search with a fresh limit, or raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION. The confirmed facts are that the role is remote, full-time, and starts at $140,000. Until reviews are checked, ask the recruiter these questions: What is the full salary range and bonus structure? Have there been layoffs or reorganizations in the last 12 to 18 months, including any left over from the InnerWorkings merger? Is the role embedded with one client, and what happens to it if that contract ends? Is the job remote for good, or is there a return-to-office or travel expectation? How long has the hiring manager been in the role, and why is this position open? How big is the creative operations team, and what tools does it use?
